rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_unconstrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.5, fd_recon_eta=0.0, fd_recon_dc=0, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.5, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-8 ETA=0 (pure prior, ZERO DPS), breast-native wdm-wavelet UNCONSTRAINED (DC OFF). SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: eta down monotonic at t=0.5: 2.0->0.0303, 1.0->0.0136, 0.5->0.01175, 0.2->0.01141 (BEST, ssim0.9315). Diminishing returns; extrapolate eta->0. (2) Failure mode: any DPS perturbs off-manifold; the pure prior-denoised-FBP is the theoretical DC-off floor. (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_eta 0.2->0.0 at t=0.5, steps=8 -- fully removes DPS soft-DC, leaving ONLY the wavelet prior denoising the FBP warm-start (the purest possible unconstrained/prior-standalone recon). (4) HYPOTHESIS: eta=0 gives the minimum DC-off rmse (~0.0114 or marginally below); if THIS cannot clear hr>0, the finding is definitive: the breast wavelet prior WITHOUT any data-consistency projection cannot beat the calibrated 128-view FBP baseline. (5) BUDGET: <5min. (6) Loop continues.
